project.name: savage-drx-server-public
project.description: Docker-oriented Savage DRX dedicated server repository with baseline game/client assets, scripts, configuration, and explicit client/server mod overlays including Summoner Arc packaging. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.
